parameters.name: FLT_TYPE
parameters.help: Bandpass filters can be applied as a single filter, or both the filters and application gates may spatially vary.

choices.label: Time and Space-Variant Filter
choices.help: Apply time and space-variant filters in space-variant time windows.

parameters.name: FLT_SPEC
parameters.help: A bandpass filter can be specified as a group of 4 frequency values, or as a group of F1-SLOPE1-F2-SLOPE2 values.

parameters.name: PHASE
parameters.help: Bandpass filters can be applied as zero phase filters, or as minimum phase filters.

parameters.name: RNOISE
parameters.help: Enter the percentage of the maximum frequency value to 'floor' the spectrum prior to conversion to minimum phase.

parameters.name: IDOMAIN
parameters.help: Single gate filters can be applied in either the TIME domain or the FREQUENCY domain.

choices.label: Frequency
choices.help: Apply the filter in the FREQUENCY domain.

choices.label: Time
choices.help: Apply the filter in the TIME domain.

parameters.name: FILT_LEN
parameters.help: Enter Hanning tapered filter length for time domain filter application (20-1000 ms).

parameters.name: PCT_PAD
parameters.help: The percent of input trace length to pad with zeroes: 100% is always safe (but slow);10% may be OK for AGC'd data.

parameters.name: notch_option
parameters.help: A notch filter may be applied at virtually any frequency and notch filter width.

parameters.name: F_NOTCH
parameters.help: Enter the center frequency of the notch filter you wish to apply.

parameters.name: N_F_WIDE
parameters.help: A 4 Hertz wide, 50 Hertz notch filter will zero frequencies from 48 to 52 Hz and apply exponential edge tapers.

parameters.name: nsearch_option
parameters.help: This program can automatically scan around the specified notch frequency for the maximum energy to set the notch filter.

parameters.name: FREQSCAN
parameters.help: A 60 Hertz, 3 Hertz wide notch search will set the notch to the maximum spectral energy between 57 and 63 Hertz.

parameters.name: FLT_FREQ1
parameters.help: Enter four 'corner' frequencies: F1(0%) - F2(100%) - F3(100%) - F4(0%).  Hanning (cosine) tapers are used for ramps.

parameters.name: FLT_FREQ2
parameters.help: Enter F1(-3dB) - DB/OCTAVE1(slope) - F2(-3dB) - DB/OCTAVE2(slope). Butterworth tapers are used for ramps

parameters.name: FLT_PARM1
parameters.help: Use MB1 to edit/define the SPACE-variant filters and locations to apply to each time gate. (SEE EDITOR EXAMPLE.)

parameters.name: FLT_PARM2
parameters.help: Use MB1 to edit/define the SPACE-variant filters and locations to apply to each time gate. (SEE EDITOR EXAMPLE.)

parameters.name: db_option
parameters.prompt: Get time gates from the DATABASE?
parameters.help: Set to 'NO' if a time-variant filter time gate parameter file was not created interactively.(Will enter manually.)

parameters.name: GATENAME
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a spatially-variant time gate parameter file from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: PRIM_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Primary time gate header word
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the HEADERS menu as the PRIMARY key for specifying filter design parameters.

parameters.name: SCND_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Secondary time gate header word
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the HEADERS menu as the SECONDARY key for specifying filter design parms.

parameters.name: FLT_GATE
parameters.help: Define time gates in which to apply requested filters (example: '1:0:0-1500,2000-4000/1:5280:0-2500,3000-4000/').

parameters.name: remute_option
parameters.help: Trace mutes (such as first break suppression mutes) may be re-applied after filtering.
